format: All UCWDC contests, all disciplines (scoring format)

source.quote_free_summary: Every UCWDC contest must use the UCWDC Majority Rules scoring format, supervised by a certified Contest Coordinator with verified scoring staff and a vetted, UCWDC-authorized scoring system.

requirement: Results of an event that declares UCWDC may be approved or published only through a scoring method verified for UCWDC. None is: the ucwdc_majority_rules registry entry is unavailable (no engine), and Studio methods carry no body source. Declared UCWDC events are blocked at approve and publish.
enforcement_point: Server actions approveRoundResultAction and publishRoundResultAction call guardRoundResultsForSanction before the database transition and refuse when blocked; the round results page and publicationControls mirror the refusal. App layer only: the database RPCs do not check the declaration (follow-up, needs SQL).

tests.name: OD-01 guard: every body x method x declaration combination

interpretation_notes: Implemented as a block, not as UCWDC scoring: the Majority Rules algorithm, Contest Coordinator certification and the UCWDC authorized-system designation are UNRESOLVED (no designation source supplied; effective_from is the edition's stated 2026 start, exact date not read from the PDF). Not verified_compliant. DanceFlow never claims UCWDC compliance. Organizer acknowledgement does not override.
decision_refs: OD-01 (owner decision 2026-11-23, BLOCK, Option C; retrospective audit PR #795)
